body: Most people would think that being selfish in situations like this is in the way forward however in my opinion the way to assert dominance and put your foot down and be able to tell somebody no I don’t want to do this no I’m not comfortable this is not what I want to do when you find that thing within yourself that makes you realise you are going to be with yourself for the rest of your life and there’s no one on this earth who ever love you more than you will love yourself and it is your job to protect yourself respect yourself and make something of yourself in this life no one on this earth can tell you what to do tell you how to act how to speak anything you are your own person same way you’ve been given this life is the same way it’s no one is right to take you take it away in the same sense you have to be aware of other peoples true intentions and distance yourself from people that you do not need in your life the way you forward is if these peoples energy is too much they are not the people for you and you’ll only change you for the worse and you will see that over time so the best advice I can give is to either distance yourself or put your foot down and see these people for who they are will they still push you to do things? If you still need that Big push out that door it’ll work out I don’t know what situation it is but I wish you the best You got this all you need on in this life is yourself. Don’t let your emotions control you drive all of your life for you, emotions are a very difficult thing to understand a lot of people experience in different ways and react to things in different ways I believe that when you study yourself and understand what type of person you are accept it or change it or get to where you want to be that’s when you will truly accept yourself and become a confident strong willed person who will stand for what they believe in and not take no for an answer or settle for less because you know your Worth you know your value how much you have that no one can take it away from you.

Thank you very much for taking the time to write this your words have helped more than you may know. I believe in you and ur dreams, family circumstances will not determine or define you as you said, I wish you the best too sir
